name: design-asset-library-registry
purpose: Registry for locally generated SVG design assets and external open-source source candidates.

reader_guide.summary: Use generated_assets for immediate legal-safe internal use. Use external_source_candidates only after license review and attribution rules are recorded.
how_to_read: Start with generation_policy to understand why these assets are stored.
Use generated_assets for actual SVG file paths.
Use external_source_candidates as research leads, not as downloaded assets.
Check license_status before public release or redistribution.
update_triggers: A new SVG pack is generated.
A third-party asset source is added.

reference_links.title: Lucide Icons License
used_for: Open-source icon source candidate and license comparison.

used_for: Open-source icon source candidate and license comparison.

structure_rules.rule: Do not store third-party SVG files until license, source URL, access date, attribution, and public-use constraints are recorded.
structure_rules.reason: The user explicitly requested legal asset collection, not illegal downloading.

structure_rules.rule: Use locally generated SVG files as the default immediately usable asset pack.
structure_rules.reason: Generated files avoid copying external copyrighted designs while still providing many reusable visual motifs.

structure_rules.rule: Every stored SVG must have a registry entry with id, path, family, rights_status, and tags.
structure_rules.reason: Future agents need source provenance before using assets in public artifacts.

field_guide.meaning: SVG files generated inside this repository and ready for internal use.

generation_policy.license_status: No third-party SVG files were copied. Public redistribution still requires the repository owner to confirm final license terms.
generation_policy.public_release_note: For public release, add an explicit project license or keep generated assets internal-only.
